notes: Uses GitHub's REST list-repository-issues endpoint anonymously for public repositories, or with an optional personal access token for private repositories and higher rate limits. Pull requests are excluded because GitHub's Issues API returns both. The first sync captures up to 500 recently updated issues; later syncs resume from updated_at in oldest-first order so busy repositories catch up over multiple passes. Issue comments are represented by their count but comment bodies are not mirrored in this version.
